class_name: 否定-不可能-テイラレナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: The speaker cannot go on remaining in the state they are in, usually because something urgent has broken in, so the form carries restlessness or alarm rather than plain inability (テレビを見てはいられない). Unlike わけにはいかない, which denies permission, this denies the possibility of continuing the current state. ではいられない also attaches straight to nouns and な-adjectives (冷静ではいられない); じゃいられない and ちゃいられない are the contracted conversational shapes.

examples.ruby: 鍋[なべ]が吹[ふ]きこぼれそうで、テレビを見[み]てはいられない。
examples.english: The pot's about to boil over — I can't sit here watching TV.

examples.ruby: 隣[となり]の部屋[へや]から悲鳴[ひめい]が聞[き]こえ、座[すわ]ってはいられなかった。
examples.english: A scream came from the next room, and I couldn't just stay in my seat.

examples.ruby: 子[こ]どもが熱[ねつ]を出[だ]した夜[よる]は、親[おや]も寝[ね]てはいられない。
examples.english: On a night when your child spikes a fever, you as the parent can't just go to sleep either.
